name: tally-campus
description: An unaffiliated, student-built Claude Code marketplace for getting around Tallahassee's campus: class schedules, walking routes, parking, and the academic calendar. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Florida State University.

plugins.name: nole-schedule
plugins.description: Import your class schedule once, then ask Claude about walking times between classes, parking, conflicts, and deadlines. Campus data is sourced from the FSU Registrar and other public pages; this is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Florida State University.
